games.name: Neon Dodge
games.about: Switch lanes, miss the blocks. It gets faster.

games.name: Pair Up
games.about: Find the pairs in as few turns as you can.

games.name: Sky Hop
games.about: Bounce up from platform to platform.

games.name: Gloamwell
games.about: Go down the well under a village: a dark-fantasy dungeon crawler with loot, talents and guardians, made for a controller.

games.name: Cinder Knight
games.about: A dark-fantasy platformer: four regions, four bosses, ember shards to find and a forge, and new moves as you go.

games.name: Shadow Heist
games.about: Stealth for one or two: twelve heists in three buildings, lamps to switch off, guards who search and radio, gadgets and ranks.

games.name: Rune Tactics
games.about: Tactics for one or two: a fifteen-battle campaign, five heroes who learn spells, fire, ice and pits, three bosses.

games.name: Micro Drifters
games.about: Top-down racing for one to four: twelve tracks in four settings, cups, time trials against your ghost, and Knockout.

games.name: Neon Brawler
games.about: A street beat 'em up through a city at night: five stages, three fighters, four bosses, one player or two together.

games.name: Void Drifter
games.about: A space run for one or two: a sector map of choices, six weapons, eight modules, four bosses, ships to unlock.

games.name: Cosmic Cascade
games.about: Falling gems for one or two: endless, sixty puzzle boards, versus with stones sent across, and a board of the day.

games.name: Tidewing
games.about: Race a skimmer over open water: twelve courses in three cups, time trials and two players on one screen, in low-poly 3D tuned to your box.

games.name: Ironmaw
games.about: A fast old-style shooter in a foundry under the ice: nine levels, seven weapons, and an arena against bots, alone or on a split screen.

native.name: Sofa Craft
native.about: Build, mine and explore an endless world of blocks, and craft what you need. It starts straight in your world.
native.note: Built on Luanti, the open-source block game. Smooth on a Pi 4 or 5; on a Pi 3 it shows less of the world.

native.name: SuperTux
native.about: Run, jump and stomp through icy worlds in a side-scrolling platformer.

native.name: Flare
native.about: A dark-fantasy action RPG: dungeons, monsters, loot and spells, in the old isometric style.

native.name: Neverball
native.about: Tilt the floor to roll the ball to the goal, picking up coins on the way.

native.name: SuperTuxKart
native.about: Kart racing with power-ups, tracks and battle arenas; up to four players on one TV.

native.name: Battle for Wesnoth
native.about: Turn-based fantasy strategy: campaigns, factions, and a story to each.

native.name: OpenTTD
native.about: Build a transport empire: trains, roads, ships and planes across a growing world.

native.name: AssaultCube
native.about: A fast first-person shooter with a realistic look: rifles, pistols and grenades in close maps, against the computer's bots.
native.note: Its maps come from AssaultCube's own site as it installs (about 50 MB). RT fires, LT aims, X reloads, LB throws a grenade.

native.name: Sauerbraten
native.about: Cube 2's fast arena shooter: big jumps, rockets and rifles, matches against bots and single-player levels.
native.note: About a 1 GB download: ten minutes or so. In its menus the right stick is the pointer and RT chooses.
